## The verdict, by the design's rule (§1)

**Every defective script is refused**, at DDL time or at check time. By the rule, Niles's schema surface becomes specification only, on this corpus.

**False refusals** (a correct twin refused): none.

## What this does not show

Fourteen cases written by the builder of the rule show that a class can slip past a mechanism, not how often one does in a bank's schema. A superuser can turn the event trigger off; the catalog pass in the gate is the answer to that, and only when the gate runs. Runtime cost of the trigger on DDL is not measured.
